arcade.name: Mule Kick
arcade.description: Pulls in on hit. Is even when done at its highest on block. Tends to bug out when done above their head. Doesn't give him a third gun as the name implies.

arcade.name: Tai Hineri
arcade.description: Air throw, leaves you a full screen lenght away from them

arcade.name: Target Combo 1
arcade.description: Only available in S.P.G, gives it a nice knockdown.

arcade.name: Target Combo 2
arcade.description: j.C loses its juggle when doing this.

arcade.name: Raimei Zan BR
arcade.description: Can be done as a feint with 2DRev. Beats Lows. Light version hits mid and isn't a true blockstring. Heavy version is unsafe most of the time. All versions can be braked. Heavy, Rev and Feint versions give you enough height to do j214BD or Super Dong Kick. Heavy, Rev and Feint versions give you enough height to do j214BD or Super Dong Kick.

arcade.name: Air Raimei Zan BR
arcade.description: All versions hit mid and can be very unsafe. All versions can be braked. You can do anything after a Brake, including another j214K, giving him a quadruple jump of sorts. You can do anything after a Brake, including another j214K, giving him a quadruple jump of sorts. You can only do each version once per jump. Rev version is +6 on hit after a 214D Brake. Only Rev version can be done as a TK input, but it must be slightly delayed else it doesn't come out in time. Very plus depending on height

arcade.name: Shiden Kyaku
arcade.description: Heavy version is a low, only comboes after clC and Counter 2C/2CRev. Death on block. Only Rev version can be braked. Can be done on startup or after the first kick. Braking the first kick leaves you +1 Can be done on startup or after the first kick. Braking the first kick leaves you +1 Light Version causes a juggle on air hit.

arcade.name: Kuusajin BR
arcade.description: Standard DP. Rev version can be canceled into another Rev Art before or with the last hit.

arcade.name: Ashi Binta BR
arcade.description: Moves him forward. Heavy and Rev versions can be braked. Rev version can be braked at 2 points during the move. Is +2 on block after either brake points. First point leaves you in throw range, second just outside of it Rev version can be braked at 2 points during the move. Is +2 on block after either brake points. First point leaves you in throw range, second just outside of it Heavy version is +6 when braked on a counter hit. Becomes a launching counter if only the last hit counters.

arcade.name: Hishou Kyaku
arcade.description: The classic Kim dive kick, worse for wear. Heavy version will never land all hits and will often leave you minus ON HIT ...avoid the heavy version.

arcade.name: Super Dong Hwan Kick
arcade.description: 10/10 name. Has no invul. Comboes off of jA and jC. If done very low to the opponent in a combo, it allows for combo extensions.

arcade.name: Super Dong Hwan Kick
arcade.description: Not even the name can save this. Still no invul but it lets him combo from back jump jA.

arcade.name: Tenshou Raimei Kyaku
arcade.description: Fully Invul. Available only in SPG.
